messages:
emma: Heads up: sample-app smoke failing on release after autogen typegen run.

ryan: saw it. stack shows auth config mismatch on startup.

ci-bot: pipeline 7201 failed at job 'integration/sample-app'.

ci-bot: ```
TypeError: init() got unexpected keyword argument 'max_attempts'
    at Object.init (/workspace/sample-app/src/server.js:14:10)
```

regen-bot: regen summary: packages/typegen/out/auth.d.ts changed. Field rename detected: 'maxAttempts' -> 'max_attempts' (snake_case normalization). Labeled 'auto:normalize'.

zoe: ugh, we standardize on camelCase in runtimes. How did snake_case land without manual review?

prashant: found the culprit: the typegen autopruner ran with a new per-language transform that applies snake_case to PR originators. It auto-merged under the 'automerge' label.

emma: immediate mitigation options: revert typegen commit OR add compatibility alias in SDK that accepts both maxAttempts and max_attempts. We should unbreak customers fast.

ryan: shim works quick. I'll open a tiny patch that maps both forms in the runtime init. Then publish a patch release.

zoe: also we need CI changes: after any typegen regen we must run a sample-app smoke test that uses the published SDK to ensure parity.

release-bot: recommended policy: require manual review for any PR that changes exported type names or field casing. Also require semver label if exported shapes changed.

prashant: opened PR to revert the autopruner normalization and added a test that asserts public field names remain camelCase: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/567.

ryan: PR for compat shim in SDK: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/998. Includes tests and changelog. Requesting patch publish.

ci-bot: PR 998 CI passed. Merging in 5m.

emma: after merge, release-bot should publish patch and run post-release verification: install the published tarball in sample-app and run smoke. If it fails, auto-revert publish.

zoe: adding follow-ups: DEVEX-401 add post-regen smoke test, DEVEX-402 require semver label on typegen exports, DEVEX-403 disallow autopruner from renaming public fields.

prashant: also updating PR templates and CODEOWNERS: make typegen a protected area that needs a human approver for any rename.

release-bot: publishing @redwood/sdk@1.10.1 (patch) now. Post-release verification will run.

ci-bot: post-release verification started (job 7202).

ryan: thanks all. Once post-release passes we'll close the revert and lock down the autogen config.

emma: good rapid response. Let's make the detection tooling a priority this sprint so regen diffs can't silently break onboarding or sample apps. :thumbsup:
